url.description: URL of the input audio file. Provide either url or audio — exactly one is required, not both.

audio.description: The audio file to transcribe. Provide either url or audio — exactly one is required, not both.

language_code.description: The language of the audio as an ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 code, for example "en" or "heb". Omit it to detect the language automatically.

diarize.description: Label which speaker says each word (speaker_0, speaker_1, …).

num_speakers.description: The maximum number of speakers in the audio, from 1 to 32. Helps speaker labelling; by default the model decides.

timestamps_granularity.description: Timing detail in the answer: "word" (the default) or "character" timings for every word, or "none".

tag_audio_events.description: Tag non-speech sounds such as (laughter) or (applause) in the transcript. On by default.

no_verbatim.description: Leave out filler words, false starts and non-speech sounds.

temperature.description: Randomness of the transcription, from 0 to 2. By default the model picks it (usually 0).

seed.description: Best-effort deterministic sampling: repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same transcript.
